name: InstantSFM
postCreateCommand: . ${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh && nvm install --lts && npm install -g @openai/codex oh-my-codex @anthropic-ai/claude-code opencode-ai && pip install nvidia-cudss-cu12==0.7.1.6 && python -m pip install --break-system-packages --no-build-isolation -v -e .
postStartCommand: mkdir -p /root/.ssh && cp -r /tmp/ssh-host/. /root/.ssh/ 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 700 /root/.ssh; chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_* 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 644 /root/.ssh/*.pub 2>/dev/null || true
